_comment: Q60 Nav runtime config — copy to /opt/nav/config/config.json on target

openweathermap._comment_key: Register free at https://openweathermap.org/api — Current Weather + 5 Day Forecast

eia._comment_key: Register free at https://www.eia.gov/opendata/ — no credit card required
eia._comment_region: PADD regions: R1X=Southeast, R10=New England, R1Y=Central Atlantic, R20=Midwest, R30=Gulf Coast, R40=Rocky Mountain, R50=West Coast

traffic._comment_tile_url: Leave empty — auto-populated from provider + api_key. Or set manually.

modem._comment_mode: Set tcu_mode=true for 2021-2022 Q60 (Continental BL28NA003). Set false for 2017-2020 or external aftermarket modem.
modem._comment_tcu: TCU mode: Continental BL28NA003 self-manages LTE. DCU sees it as RNDIS USB adapter (usb0). No APN/PIN needed. Run 'ip link' after boot to confirm interface name.
modem._comment_interface: External modem interface (ignored in tcu_mode). wwan0=QMI/MBIM, ppp0=PPP. Check 'ip link' after modem attaches.
modem._comment_apn: Carrier APN (external modem only): AT&T=broadband, T-Mobile=fast.t-mobile.com, Verizon=vzwinternet
modem._comment_pin: SIM PIN if required (external modem only). Leave empty if SIM is unlocked.

location._comment: Cary NC — used before GPS lock and for weather/fuel area defaults
